description:
## Why

Surfaced during PKIX-agp7.2 sweep. The top-level README.md crate table (lines 24-30) shows 'v0.2' for every crate, but the coordinated 0.3 follow-up wave (CHANGELOG [unreleased]) ships pkix-path 0.3.0, pkix-revocation 0.3.2, pkix-chain 0.4.0, pkix-chain-simple 0.4.0, and pkix-path-builder 0.3.0.

This is a data-freshness issue, not a v0.x-gating policy issue, which is why it was left out of PKIX-agp7.2.

## What

Two options:
1. Update the Version column to reflect actual Cargo.toml versions.
2. Remove the Version column entirely — version info already lives in crates.io and individual Cargo.toml files; the README table doesn't need to mirror it.

Pick 2 if 'drive to done done done' means no version-pegged status surfaces; pick 1 if the table is genuinely informative for new readers.

## Acceptance

- [ ] README.md crate table either has accurate per-crate versions or no Version column.
- [ ] No stale 'v0.2' references in the README outside CHANGELOG history.
title: README crate-version column shows stale v0.2 for crates already at 0.3+
